execution_design.title: NURBS Curve Control Points Knots Weights
execution_design.goal_from_canonical: control point, degree, knot, weight semantics
execution_design.positive_oracle_proposed: Cubic NURBS curve stores degree=3, knot vector, weights/control point count correctly
execution_design.negative_oracle_proposed: Mismatch knot cardinality/zero weights rejected before OCCT conversion
execution_design.reuse_approval_condition: Audit local checkout at pinned SHA, compile/tests, M00 human legal approval; do not infer ready from static GitHub read.
execution_design.implementation_owner_policy: One owning L2, UI modules dispatch only. No source code changes in vendor-research/ unless approved fork.
objectives: Define typed seam + explicitly testable oracle
Implement one capability at its canonical owner
Verify failure rollback, stable IDs/units/geometry as relevant

plugin_sdk_v1_curves.target: standalone Rust OM9, Windows x64 host with an out-of-checkout .om9p plugin
plugin_sdk_v1_curves.scope: Curve reading and evaluation: curve_info reports kind, native domain and NURBS degree/pole count/periodic/reversed; evaluate_curve runs the owner's evaluation::evaluate_curve at native parameters with D1-D3 in object-local millimetres (<=1024 samples, order <=3). A polycurve reports segment count and is refused for a single-parameter evaluation. Placement is not applied.
limitations: Partial scope only: construction, editing, offset, fillet/blend, rebuild and intersections remain open.
Polycurve segment parameters and NURBS weights/knots are not exposed.

plugin_sdk_v1_curve_definition.target: standalone Rust OM9, Windows x64 host with an out-of-checkout .om9p plugin
plugin_sdk_v1_curve_definition.scope: curve_definition returns NURBS degree, poles, weights, knots, domain, periodic, reversed and seam, a circle's optional arc angle domain and a polycurve's segment count. Control data is bounded to 8192 poles and 16384 knots per definition; a larger curve is a budget refusal rather than a truncated definition. Read-only.
limitations: Read-only: weights/knots write and point/knot editing remain open.
